I I don't really agree with not including Winnie The Pooh. The 100 Acre Wood was a fun little side part of the first 2, not necessary yet not unnecessary. I liked them and don't see a reason for another not be be in the third installment, but definitely again as a little side world. It would be a total waste to make it a full one.

I do agree with not including Atlantis (though maybe add another water world? I just want to see more shirtless Sora) and Holloween town because they both have had their fair share of space in the series. Personally, aside from unique ones like the Colosseum and Mickeys Castle, I would like to see all original worlds. Which leads me into Frozen which, while I agree there would be better alternatives to, I don't feel like would be too bad of a pick. There would be some neat potential in that one too I think.
